reading_notes: The incoming SYN/SYNC line enters R3 from the left. It crosses the vertical 0 V return bus without a junction dot.
R3 exits to the upper node labelled test point 2. C2 connects that upper node to the 0 V bus.
C1 crosses from test point 2 to the lower integration node; R20 connects that lower node to the 0 V bus.
The lower node continues to the oscillator circuitry, which is deliberately outside this four-part scope.

The first read wrongly joined the crossing SYNC and 0 V lines. A comparison with the exported model prompted this source-image re-read; the absence of a junction dot and the bottom 0 V return settle the crossing.

The scan does not number the leads of these four unpolarized passive parts. Terminal labels L/R/T/B describe drawing orientation only; comparison uses each component's unordered pair of endpoint nets.
